summary: The proof is mathematically complete. The canonical product matching satisfies the required strong degree bounds; optimality of the restricted pairing LP forces every positive-residual component onto an affine lattice line; the accepted rank-one slice capacity bound controls the residual load in the small-core regime, while the total matching mass controls it in the complementary regime; and the support-function estimates convert the load decomposition into the claimed interaction inequality. The zero-load, empty-support, equality-threshold, and low-dimensional cases are handled consistently.
